title: Onboarding's 'Regulated cooling' toggle never enables cooling; the camera runs at ambient every session
what_happened: Onboarding step 9 'Set your capture defaults' has a 'Regulated cooling' switch ('Turn on for a cooled camera; leave off for a DSLR or an uncooled sensor'). I turned it ON and it revealed 'Cooling set-point -10 C'. The saved profile has default_cooling_temp=-10.0 but cool_on_connect=0. On every connect the camera sat at 20.0 C with the cooler at 0%, and the app log shows it polling and doing nothing: '[CameraTemperaturePoller] Camera temp: 20.0C, power: 0%, target: -10.0C'. The connect sequence issues camera_set_gain and camera_set_offset but no cooling command at all. The manual 'Cool to -10C' button works (reaches -10.0 C / 35% within ~50 s), and ticking the hidden 'Cool on connect' checkbox inside Equipment > Edit Profile > Camera Defaults makes the camera cool automatically on the next Connect All -- so the feature works; only the wizard fails to wire it. There is also no cooling control anywhere in Settings: searching Settings for 'cool' returns 'No settings match your search', while app_settings holds cooling_behavior='On Connect' with no UI and no effect.
expected: Turning on 'Regulated cooling' with a set-point in the wizard should set cool_on_connect=1 so the camera actually reaches the set-point when it connects. Otherwise the switch is decorative and a first-run user images all night on a warm sensor.
repro: 1. Fresh profile, walk onboarding, step 9: turn 'Regulated cooling' ON, leave set-point -10. Save profile. 2. sqlite3 <db> 'select cool_on_connect,default_cooling_temp from equipment_profiles' -> 0 | -10.0. 3. Equipment > Connect All. Camera card shows 20.0 C / 0% / Idle indefinitely. 4. Equipment > Edit Profile > Camera Defaults > tick 'Cool on connect' > Save. 5. Disconnect All, Connect All -> camera card shows -10.0 C / 35%.
evidence: /tmp/ns-audit/shots/crop-cool.png (wizard toggle ON + set-point -10), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/crop-camcard3.png (20.0C/0% after reconnect), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/crop-ep5.png ('Cool on connect' unchecked in Edit Profile), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/crop-cool4.png (-10.0C/35% after enabling it), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/crop-searchcool.png ('No settings match your search' for 'cool'), /tmp/ns-audit/shots/dumplog.txt line 'Camera temp: 20.0C, power: 0%, target: -10.0C'
proposed_fix: Map the wizard's 'Regulated cooling' switch to cool_on_connect (and keep default_cooling_temp for the set-point). Also either surface or delete the orphaned app_settings key cooling_behavior='On Connect', which has no UI and no effect.
verdict_reasoning: The factual core is confirmed in code but the finding's framing is over-called. packages/skotiq_core/lib/src/providers/onboarding_provider.dart:429 hardcodes coolOnConnect: false, with an explicit 8-line comment stating this is deliberate ('we never auto-run the TEC on connect just because a set-point exists: a setup done in the middle of a summer day must not pin the cooler at full power for hours'). The wizard control (packages/skotiq_app/lib/screens/onboarding/steps/camera_defaults_step.dart:359-361) is labelled 'Regulated cooling / Turn on for a cooled camera; leave off for a DSLR or an uncooled sensor' -- it is a camera-capability question, it never promises cool-on-connect, and it is not decorative: it gates and persists default_cooling_temp. So 'the toggle never enables cooling' is true only against an expectation the UI does not set. The orphan-setting sub-claim IS fully confirmed and is the real defect here: 'cooling_behavior' defaults to 'On Connect' (database/default_settings.dart:55), is round-tripped through every settings mapper, has zero consumers that act on it (grep across packages/ and apps/ excluding generated files finds only storage/mapping), and has no UI -- I reproduced 'No settings match your search' for 'cool' (/tmp/ns-audit/shots/eqv-22-searchcool.png). Severity P1 -> P3.
